column1: Table 2. Association of area disadvantage and metropolitan status with accredited facility counts

EDI = economic deprivation index; IRR = incidence rate ratio; NA = not applicable; SVI = Social Vulnerability Index. Negative binomial regression with the dispersion parameter estimated from the data and a log-population offset (adults aged ≥45 years); adjusted models include metropolitan status (RUCC 1–3). Metropolitan estimates shown are from the EDI models; corresponding SVI-model estimates were 8.55 (95% CI, 5.01–14.59) for cardiac MR and 2.08 (95% CI, 1.71–2.54) for cardiac CT. Sensitivity analyses, including a specification with the dispersion fixed at 1, are reported in Supplementary Table S2. P values are unadjusted; Holm-adjusted P values for the four adjusted index associations (the primary hypothesis family) were 1.000 (SVI, cardiac MR), 0.030 (SVI, cardiac CT), 1.000 (EDI, cardiac MR), and 0.559 (EDI, cardiac CT). Analytic sample: 3,144 counties (SVI), 3,134 (EDI).
